title: Org-user write endpoints redirect to k8s only for single-org + current-org + flag
answers: When does DELETE/PUT org user use kubernetes instead of legacy SQL?
Why isn't my org-user write going through the k8s User API?
How to add a new k8s-redirected org-user write path
body: Org-user write handlers (update, delete) only redirect to the k8s-backed path when all three hold: the command targets the caller's current org (cmd.OrgID == c.GetOrgID()), hs.Cfg.RBAC.SingleOrganization is true, and featuremgmt.FlagKubernetesUsersRedirect is enabled via openfeature. Cross-org variants (e.g. RemoveOrgUser vs RemoveOrgUserForCurrentOrg) always keep using the legacy org service. Skipping any of these three checks would send writes through k8s in multi-org deployments where k8s user data isn't authoritative.
applies: pkg/api/org_users.go write handlers for org users (update/delete); any new k8s-redirected org-user write endpoint should follow the same three-part gate.
